title: Inactive part's dialog shows a grey Inactive badge in the title row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = one tracked part, set inactive in Setup. [Part-B] = one tracked part, active.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BADGE A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BADGE-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BADGE-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BADGE A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BADGE B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BADGE-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BADGE-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BADGE B).
  5. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  6. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab and [Part-B] on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click the Inactive tab and search [Part-A].
  2. Click the [Part-A] row.
  3. Read the dialog's title row and the Part Status choice.
  4. Close the dialog with ×.
  5. On the Active tab search [Part-B] and click its row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The dialog is titled "Edit Inventory Part" and shows a grey "Inactive" pill beside the close ×; Part Status has "Inactive" picked.
  • Step 4: The dialog closes with nothing changed.
  • Step 5: [Part-B]'s dialog shows a green "Active" pill in the same place.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-R14, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.6 (Opening the inactive part) and 3.1 (Part Status in the dialog). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
